entities.summary: Mežaparks Lutheran Church is a Lutheran church in Riga, the capital of Latvia. It is a parish church of the Evangelical Lutheran Church of Latvia. The church is situated at the address 1 Roberta Feldmaņa Street. Worship is offered in both Latvian and Russian languages.
